text: The Grand Class brand (grandclass.es, luxury chauffeured car rental in Madrid) is owned by Lopez Rubio Grand Class SL, which per its legal notice is titular of the website under Spain's LSSI-CE, with NIF B81914095 registered in Madrid.
short: Grand Class is the brand of Lopez Rubio Grand Class SL (NIF B81914095).

source.name: Grand Class, Aviso legal
source.quote: En cumplimiento de la Ley 34/2002, de 11 de julio, de Servicios de la Sociedad de la Información y de Comercio Electrónico (LSSI-CE), LOPEZ RUBIO GRAND CLASS SL informa que es titular del sitio web.
